_notes: Domain concept → what the platform already has. DATA, not a prompt.
This is the deterministic half of gap detection: before a capability gap is recorded, the concept is resolved here and against the live feature catalog. Only what resolves to nothing becomes a gap.
Its job is to stop FALSE gaps. A model that reports 'weather' as unavailable is wrong — temp, wind and roof_dome exist — and this file is what corrects it without another model call.
`features` are catalog column names, checked against the live catalog at runtime; a column listed here that no longer exists is caught by a test, not silently ignored.

`filterable` says whether the concept can also be used as a GameUniverseFilter slice. Today almost nothing is: the filter schema accepts only div_game and week. A concept with features but filterable=false is expressible as a model input and NOT as a subset — which is a real and different limitation, and the one most hypotheses actually run into.
